messages:
Eleni (Content): quick thread to coordinate the OSS refapp launch. deliverables: short blog post, 10-min tutorial, micro-benchmark notebook, and a 30-min 'build-with' webinar. target: one week.
Sam (DevRel): tutorial constraints: runnable in ~10m, include Dockerfile + a GitHub Actions CI job to run the bench on PR. keep examples tiny.
Priya (Growth): inbound flow: landing page -> HubSpot form. require name,email,company and an 'enterprise interest' checkbox. set utm_campaign=refapp_launch. also want a hidden field for source.
Marco (Engineering): bench plan: stock vs tuned at seq=256. report p50/p95 and tokens/sec. I'll drop a reproducible script and a one-line hero stat. preliminary run shows ~2.7x tokens/sec.
June (Design): assets: hero image, two social cards, one slide template. need final hero stat by Wed noon to lock layouts.
Sam (DevRel): I'll wire the webhook to /webhooks/hubspot and post alerts to #sales-leads. adding Clearbit enrichment to flag >100 employees.
LeadBot: webhook test started for form id=refapp_launch_form. status: delivered=3, errors=0.
Priya (Growth): promo plan: announce email + 24h reminder + social cadence. CTA A/B: "Register for live" vs "Try the repo". we'll A/B in email.
Marco (Engineering): quick command for bench: `python -m refbench --model tuned --seq 256 --iters 50`. will validate numbers and upload bench_256.json.
June (Design): ✅ uploading first pass tonight. will make a square + wide social image.
Sam (DevRel): ✅ repo scaffold + CI on staging. webhooks tested.
Marco (Engineering): ✅ bench initial pass done, will finalize p95 and tokens/sec tomorrow AM.
Eleni (Content): action items: blog draft (me), tutorial + repo (Sam), bench + notebook (Marco), assets (June), landing + form (Priya). post checks in the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/refapp-launch-draft
Eleni (Content): thanks — prioritize the hero stat and webhook so we can start ads tracking. ping here with blockers. :sparkles:
